description: Get the Free Tools Builder state of a product: plan, tool counts and keyword planner slots. data.subscription is null on a product without a Free Tools Builder plan; the human subscribes in the dashboard at data.links.subscribe_url. data.subscription.can_build is false on the Hosting plan, while past due or outside the paid period. data.planner.available_slots says how many keywords the planner still takes.
name: free_tools_status
title: Free tools status
